verdict.rationale: A community report describes running embedding workloads on Baseten at enough throughput that the client became the bottleneck, which led to the Rust-based Performance Client for concurrent requests. Baseten's own docs also say you can deploy any open-source or custom model on dedicated GPUs. That makes in-platform embedding generation plausible, but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of an embeddings endpoint or of reranking. Missing for 10: first-party docs for an embeddings API or hosted embedding models, any evidence of reranking support, details on retrieval-pipeline integration.
